stories.title: Carolina Thanksgiving week forecast: Fog, brisk winds, and midweek rain expected
stories.summary: Prepare for a weather rollercoaster in Charlotte this Thanksgiving week with fog, sunshine, and rain affecting travel plans and outdoor activities.

stories.title: Teenager killed in southwest Charlotte shooting, CMPD investigating homicide
stories.summary: The homicide happened on Nations Ford Road near E Arrowood Road.

stories.title: Thanksgiving event offers free dental, health screenings in community partnership
stories.summary: Families received more than just turkeys at T.E.A.M. Inc.'s annual giveaway, which offered free dental and vision care while emphasizing holistic health and community support.

stories.title: One person hurt in southwest Charlotte shooting
stories.summary: The shooting happened on Holliswood Court off South Tryon.

stories.title: Suspect in custody after man shot in leg during Huntersville altercation Saturday night
stories.summary: Sergio Vanegas was taken into custody without incident shortly after 9 p.m.

stories.title: Winterfest brings holiday magic, community spirit to University City
stories.summary: The annual event featured about 60 vendors and was expected to have more than 15,000 attendees.

stories.title: More than 600 Gastonia families get Thanksgiving turkey dinners at community giveaway
stories.summary: Police said there were lots of smiles at Mt. Zion Restoration Church, where volunteers gave away turkey dinners to more than 600 Gastonia families in need.

stories.title: Pedestrian killed in hit-and-run crash in southwest Charlotte
stories.summary: The crash happened on South Tryon Street near West Arrowood Road.

stories.title: 'Quinn had other plans': Owner of viral Panthers corgi speaks on the halftime sprint
stories.summary: Quinn the corgi ditched her halftime race and dodged tacklers at Bank of America Stadium. Now she's talking fame, the Today Show and Sunday's game.

stories.title: Shred truck catches fire at Huntersville Police's document shred event
stories.summary: A shred truck caught fire during Huntersville's document shredding event. Firefighters suspect a lithium battery hidden in the shred donations was the cause.

stories.title: CMPD identifies suspect in east Charlotte homicide
stories.summary: The victim found dead in the area of the Evergreen Nature Preserve on Wednesday.

stories.title: Motorcyclist dies after hitting curb and street sign in south Charlotte
stories.summary: A 59-year-old motorcyclist died early Saturday after a crash on Steele Creek Road. CMPD said speed was a factor.
